title: Digital Down-Converter
text: Translate digital signal from intermediate frequency (IF) band to baseband and decimate it, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Decimation factor} sets Decimation factor; {Minimum order filter design} sets the design minimum-order filter, {Number of sections of CIC decimator} sets the number of sections in CIC decimator, {Order of third filter stage}, {Source of stopband frequency}, {Type of oscillator}, {Center frequency of output signal}, {Order of CIC compensation filter stage}, {Two-sided bandwidth of input signal}, {Stopband frequency}, {Passband ripple of cascade response (dB)}, {Stopband attenuation of cascade response (dB)}, {Number of NCO accumulator bits}, {Number of NCO quantized accumulator bits}, {Dither control for NCO}, {Number of NCO dither bits}, {Sample rate mode} sets the mode to specify the input sample rate Use normalized, {Input sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate of input, {View Filter Response}, {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted, {Stage input}, {Output}, {Minimum}, {Maximum} and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.
